seoTitle: Indianapolis Public Schools Calendar 2025–26: Key Dates
seoDescription: Indianapolis Public Schools starts Aug. 4, 2025 and ends May 21, 2026. See IPS breaks, 3 asynchronous days, quarters, the official PDF, and ICS.
heroSummary: Indianapolis Public Schools students begin Monday, August 4, 2025, and finish Thursday, May 21, 2026. Fall Break is October 13–17, Thanksgiving Break is November 26–28, Winter Break is December 22–January 2, and Spring Break is March 16–20. IPS publishes 180 student days, including three asynchronous-learning days, and 192 staff days.

calendarNotes: The IPS sheet is a combined student and staff calendar. Students begin August 4, after July induction, professional-development, and teacher work dates. September 2 and November 3 are staff professional-development days with no school. October 24 and March 27 are Student Progress Conference dates with Student Asynchronous Learning; February 17 is staff professional development with Student Asynchronous Learning. These three dates are instructional, not vacation days, and IPS counts one asynchronous day in semester 1 and two in semester 2. December 18 is the last student day of semester 1, December 19 is a no-school records day, and students return January 5. Quarter 4 is printed as March 16–May 20 even though Spring Break also begins March 16; that official overlap is preserved rather than adjusted. May 21 is the last student day, followed by a staff-only records day May 22. Memorial Day and Juneteenth appear on the staff calendar after students finish.
allDatesCoverageNote: This table follows the one-page IPS Student & Staff School Calendar, including pre-year staff dates, student no-school days, asynchronous-learning days, semester markers, breaks, and post-year staff holidays. Asynchronous days are instructional and are not labeled as no-school days.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Indianapolis Public Schools start in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for IPS students was Monday, August 4, 2025. New-teacher induction and staff work or professional-development dates began in July.

calendarFaqs.q: When was IPS Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: IPS Fall Break ran Monday, October 13 through Friday, October 17, 2025. Students returned Monday, October 20 for the beginning of Quarter 2.

calendarFaqs.q: When was IPS Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026. The first student day of semester 2 was Monday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When was IPS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran Monday, March 16 through Friday, March 20, 2026. The IPS calendar also prints March 16 as the start of Quarter 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Were IPS asynchronous-learning days school days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. October 24, February 17, and March 27 were asynchronous instructional days. IPS includes all three in its published total of 180 student days.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day for IPS students in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day was Thursday, May 21, 2026. May 22 was a staff-only records and yearly-close day.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 16, 2026 against the official one-page IPS SY2025-26 English Student & Staff School Calendar and the IPS live calendar hub.
sourceReviewDetails: The English PDF is image-based, so its single page was rendered at high resolution and visually checked for every dated legend item, quarter range, semester count, student total, staff total, and professional-development list.
The student total is 180 days: semester 1 has 88 days including one asynchronous day, and semester 2 has 92 days including two asynchronous days. The staff total is 192 days.

The official printable collection is labeled for District and Innovation Network calendars. This page uses the English IPS district Student & Staff School Calendar and does not claim that every network school follows it without exception.
